state_boundaries.description: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary file, states, 2018, 1:500k

urban_areas.description: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2024 release of 2020 Census urban areas (UAC20)

terminals.published_date_source: BTS catalog page (Published Date: July 10, 2024, 12:00:00 AM EDT); not embedded in the file
terminals.description: BTS National Transportation Atlas Database, Intermodal Freight Facilities, Rail TOFC/COFC. file_modified is the local download timestamp. Operating status not provided or assumed.

grid.origin: snapped to multiples of cell size in EPSG:5070

rural_definition: Grid cells clipped to the study region minus 2020 Census urban areas; disconnected remnants exploded into separate features.

distance_method.type: Straight-line geodesic distance on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj.Geod.inv)
distance_method.origin_point: Interior representative point of each rural polygon (shapely representative_point)
distance_method.candidates: All valid U.S. terminals nationally, including those outside the study region
distance_method.datum_note: NAD83 inputs treated as coincident with WGS84 (sub-2 m difference, immaterial at mile scale)
distance_method.not_network_distance: Distances are not road or rail network distances.
distance_method.within_cell_variation: Distance is evaluated at one sample point per polygon. Nearest-terminal distance changes by at most the distance moved, so within a 5-km cell it can differ from the reported value by up to the cell diagonal (4.4 mi). Acceptable for an exploratory map.

distance_bands.rule: lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive
distance_bands.note: Display categories only; not commercial viability thresholds.
